method: Public page result and annual-schedule numeric observations via web browser text. Form values were not independently read.
inference: First two pre-tax annual changes imply 6% annual growth and a $7500 year-end contribution. Initial after-tax ratios imply 25% current and 15% retirement tax assumptions; visible ages imply 35 years. This is a model inference, not an independent reading of form controls.
scope: Selected default-result numeric checkpoints only. No parity claim for negative-return loss credits, account eligibility, annual limits, conversion taxes or every reference scenario.
